title: 第五百六十七章 人生若只如初见结局第五百六十六章 做的事情要负责
content_zh:
“陆……陆原？”
当赵思思被带到陆原面前的时候，她整个人都懵了。
心里各种滋味交集在一起，一时之间，十分复杂。
“对不起，陆原，对不起，是我错了，是我误会了你，我不该认为你回来找我是为了赔偿金，我不该相信他们的话，这个世界上，除了爸爸，最关心我的人，其实是你，一直都是你……呜呜……”
想起之前自己错怪了陆原那些事，赵思思真的是又羞又愧。
“没事了，没事了。”
陆原轻轻拍着赵思思的肩膀，“以后再也不会有人欺负你了。”
说到这里，他沉吟了一下，又补充道，“再也不会有人欺负你们娘儿俩了。”
安慰赵思思的时候，他的语气是温柔的。
但是转过头，陆原的语气一瞬间就变得森然，“彻查赵宝良的死因，凡事与这件事相关的所有责任人，包括隐瞒包庇之内的，都严格查办！江阳市积弊太久，岭南所也该好好整治一下这个地方了！”
“是，三少爷！”
王奉天立即恭敬回应。
其实这个时候，陆原的身份，已经不是少爷这么简单了，他已经是陆家的一把手，七十二所统领。
但是他依然保留了这个称呼。
没有人知道为什么，也许，是为了某种纪念。
“走吧，我带你去一个地方。”
陆原牵起赵思思的手，上了车。
“你们刚才听到三少爷的话了？从现在开始，你们所有人，24小时接受岭南所调查！”目送陆原离开，王奉天转头喝道。
崔家的人，赵家的人，以及张莲香他们一大家子，此时所有人都面如死灰，但依然可以隐隐看到之前脸上那凝固的惊愕。
“爸，女儿来看你了。”

写着“赵宝良之墓”的坟前，赵思思悲怆的跪在地上，黑灰色的纸钱迎风飞舞。
“赵叔叔是个好人，他是真正的父亲。”陆原坐在旁边，感慨道。
“再也不会有人像他那样疼爱我了，照顾我了，爸爸……”赵思思又哭起来。
“会的，会的。”看着赵思思哭的这么悲痛，陆原不知道怎么的，心里很不是滋味，一种说不出的难过充盈心头，“我曾经答应过赵叔叔，我会保护你，照顾你，疼爱你的……”
“你，真的会吗？”赵思思抬起头，泪水朦胧的看着陆原。
“会，当然。”
她那本就美丽不可方物的脸蛋，加上这雨打梨花一般的样子，陆原只觉得心里升起一种奇怪的爱意。
不，我这只是保护她，接替赵叔叔去疼爱她，绝不是有所企图，我没有对不起周允。
赵思思脸突然微红起来。
她低着头，不说话了。
“对了，还有一件事，我的人，已经治好了你的妈妈，我们现在就去看看她吧！”
陆原看着手机里，章九发来的信息说道。
“好！”
赵思思悲伤的脸上，终于有了一点好转。
此时此刻，妈妈这个词，对她的意义，已经只有曹凤了。
张莲香做的那些事，已经让赵思思认透了她的人品和本质，也彻底和她断绝了关系。
所以当岭南所在调查张莲香的时候，张莲香数次向调查人员哀求，表示她的身份是赵思思的妈妈，“你们的三少爷身边那个女孩子，是我的女儿，我是她妈妈，求求你们给我女儿转个话吧！我女儿是三少爷极其重要的朋友，我也是，你们可不能胡来啊！”
调查人员当然也知道赵思思的分量，所以也不敢怠慢，口信自然也传到了赵思思这里。
当然，当赵思思此时此刻知道了张莲香真实人格之后，也没有理会了。
而对于曹凤，也许是血脉的联系，也许是因为那次曹凤短暂的清醒之后的母女交谈，她对曹凤日益思念起来。

“那走吧！”
其实，周尚此时此刻，也想立刻见到曹凤，因为，他也有很多话要问，很多话要说。
直升机载着他们两人，在太平洋上飞行了两个小时左右，终于，慢慢的降落在了陆家的桃花岛上。
“妈！”
content_en:
"Lu...Lu Yuan?"
When Zhao Sisi was brought to Lu Yuan, she was completely stunned.
All kinds of feelings in my heart were mixed together, and for a moment, it was very complicated.
"I'm sorry, Lu Yuan, I'm sorry. It was my fault. I misunderstood you. I shouldn't have thought that you came back to me for compensation. I shouldn't have believed their words. In this world, apart from my father, the person who cares about me the most is actually you. It has always been you... Wuwu..."
Zhao Sisi felt really ashamed and ashamed when she recalled the things she had wrongly blamed Lu Yuan for.
"It's okay, it's okay."
Lu Yuan gently patted Zhao Sisi on the shoulder, "No one will bully you again."
At this point, he pondered for a moment and then added, "No one will bully you two anymore."
When comforting Zhao Sisi, his tone was gentle.
But turning his head, Lu Yuan's tone became serious in an instant, "Thoroughly investigate the cause of Zhao Baoliang's death. All responsible persons related to this matter, including those who concealed and protected them, will be strictly investigated and punished! Jiangyang City has been suffering from evil for too long, and it is time for the Lingnan Institute to rectify this place!"
"Yes, Third Young Master!"
Wang Fengtian immediately responded respectfully.
In fact, at this time, Lu Yuan's identity was no longer as simple as a young master. He was already the top leader of the Lu family and the commander of the Seventy-Two.
But he still retained the title.
No one knows why, maybe, it was for some kind of commemoration.
"Let's go, I'll take you somewhere."
Lu Yuan took Zhao Sisi's hand and got into the car.
"Did you just hear what the third young master said? From now on, all of you will be investigated by the Lingnan Institute 24 hours a day!" Wang Fengtian turned around and shouted after Lu Yuan left.
The Cui family, the Zhao family, and Zhang Lianxiang's family all looked ashen at this time, but you could still faintly see the frozen shock on their faces before.
"Dad, my daughter is here to see you."
In front of the grave with the words "Zhao Baoliang's Tomb" written on it, Zhao Sisi knelt on the ground sadly, with black and gray paper money flying in the wind.
"Uncle Zhao is a good man, he is a real father." Lu Yuan sat next to him and said with emotion.
"No one will ever love me and take care of me like him again, dad..." Zhao Sisi started crying again.
"Yes, yes." Seeing Zhao Sisi crying so sadly, Lu Yuan didn't know why, but he felt very uncomfortable. An indescribable sadness filled his heart, "I once promised Uncle Zhao that I would protect you, take care of you, and love you..."
"Do you really know how to do it?" Zhao Sisi raised her head and looked at Lu Yuan with tears in her eyes.
"Yes, of course."
With her incomparably beautiful face and her look like pear blossoms being beaten by the rain, Lu Yuan felt a strange love rising in his heart.
No, I was just protecting her and pampering her in place of Uncle Zhao. It was definitely not for any purpose. I didn't feel sorry for Zhou Yun.
Zhao Sisi's face suddenly turned red.
She lowered her head and stopped talking.
"By the way, one more thing. My people have cured your mother. Let's go see her now!"
Lu Yuan looked at the message sent by Zhang Jiu on his phone and said.
"Okay!"
Zhao Sisi's sad face finally improved a little.
At this moment, the word mother only meant Cao Feng to her.
The things Zhang Lianxiang did had made Zhao Sisi recognize her character and essence, and completely severed ties with her.
So when Lingnan was investigating Zhang Lianxiang, Zhang Lianxiang begged the investigators several times, saying that she was Zhao Sisi's mother, "The girl next to your third young master is my daughter, and I am her mother. Please send a message to my daughter! My daughter is an extremely important friend of the third young master, and so am I. You can't do this!"
Of course the investigators also know Zhao Sisi’s weight, so they don’tIf you dare to neglect, the message will naturally reach Zhao Sisi.
Of course, when Zhao Sisi learned about Zhang Lianxiang's true personality at this moment, she ignored him.
As for Cao Feng, maybe it was the blood connection, maybe it was because of the mother-daughter conversation after Cao Feng briefly regained consciousness, that she missed Cao Feng day by day.
"Then let's go!"
In fact, Zhou Shang wanted to see Cao Feng immediately at this moment, because he also had a lot to ask and say.
The helicopter flew the two of them over the Pacific Ocean for about two hours, and finally slowly landed on the Lu family's Peach Blossom Island.
"mom!"
